GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Slow Out 1/2 length Settled Down 2nd 1 length. 2nd turn under pressure. weakened. Every Chance # Ordinary Effort
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Slipped behind on jumping, lost ground and raced three-wide throughout. Passing the 900m was shifted out to avoid heels. When questioned, rider advised that her mount travelled well and she was confident of her mount’s prospects entering the straight, however from this point her mount did not respond to her riding and was most disappointing. A post-race vet exam revealed the mare to have a poor recovery rate. Trainer was told that he would be required to provide a veterinary clearance prior to the mare being permitted to race again.
